purpose: Three material variants of one lidded storage chest for a small exploration game; no baked text
meaning: Same chest seen from the front with a little of its top visible; lid boundary and latch or handle
shared_geometry: Identical per-pixel alpha and silhouette, orientation and main structural positions; material texture, shading and reflections may differ
materials: Wood, metal and stone should use material cues beyond only recoloring; style and palette are free
